use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Random

union Move is
    ROCK
    PAPER
    SCISSORS
si

parse(text: string) -> Move =>
    case text
    when "rock" then Move.ROCK
    when "paper" then Move.PAPER
    when "scissors" then Move.SCISSORS
    else throw System.Exception("unrecognised move: {text}")
    esac

name(move: Move) -> string =>
    case move
    when _: Move.ROCK then "rock"
    when _: Move.PAPER then "paper"
    when _: Move.SCISSORS then "scissors"
    esac

beats(a: Move, b: Move) -> bool =>
    (a =~ Move.ROCK /\ b =~ Move.SCISSORS) \/
    (a =~ Move.SCISSORS /\ b =~ Move.PAPER) \/
    (a =~ Move.PAPER /\ b =~ Move.ROCK)

counters(move: Move) -> Move =>
    case move
    when _: Move.ROCK then Move.PAPER
    when _: Move.PAPER then Move.SCISSORS
    when _: Move.SCISSORS then Move.ROCK
    esac

let random = Random(7)
let counts = MAP[string, int]()

counts["rock"] = 1
counts["paper"] = 1
counts["scissors"] = 1

let computer_wins mut = 0
let player_wins mut = 0
let ties mut = 0

let choose_computer_move = () -> Move is
    let total = counts["rock"] + counts["paper"] + counts["scissors"]
    let target = random.next(0, total)

    if target < counts["rock"] then
        counters(Move.ROCK)
    elif target < counts["rock"] + counts["paper"] then
        counters(Move.PAPER)
    else
        counters(Move.SCISSORS)
    fi

    let move_text = line
    let player_move = parse(move_text)
    let computer_move = choose_computer_move()
    let played =

    counts[move_text] = counts[move_text] + 1

    if beats(player_move, computer_move) then

        write_line("{played}, you win")

        computer_wins = computer_wins + 1
        write_line("{played}, computer wins")
